items.title: 11.1 Domains and Ranges of Sine and Cosine Functions (Roman Urdu)

blocks.text: Assalam o alaikum bachon! Aaj hum ek naya aur bohat dilchasp unit shuru kar rahe hain: Trigonometric Functions and their Graphs. Pichle unit mein aap ne identities seekhi thin; ab hum dekhenge ke yeh functions kaisa bartao (behaviour) karte hain, kahan tak jaate hain, kab dohraate hain aur graph par kaise nazar aate hain. Kitab is unit ka taaruf (introduction) kuch is tarah karti hai.

Is unit mein hum woh bunyadi tasawwurat (key concepts) seekhenge jo maths aur rozmarra zindagi mein trigonometry ka kirdar samajhne ke liye zaroori hain. Sab se pehle hum trigonometric functions ka domain aur range nikalna seekhenge, taa ke un ka bartao samajh aaye. Phir even aur odd functions, aur un ki periodicity (baar baar dohraane ki khaasiyat) parhenge, jo un ke repeat hone wale patterns ki wajah batati hai.

Us ke baad sine, cosine aur tangent functions ke graph banana aur unhein samajhna seekhenge. Phir sinusoidal functions (sine jaise lehar wale functions) ki maximum aur minimum values nikalenge, aur un ki khaas cheezein jaise amplitude (lehar ki unchai), frequency aur phase shift (lehar ka khisakna) dekhenge.

Aakhir mein yeh sab baatein navigation, engineering aur physics ke amali (practical) masail mein lagayenge, jaise faasle nikalna, solar panel ka behtareen angle chun'na aur structures mein forces ka hisaab. Kitab kehti hai: graph banane se pehle aaiye trigonometric functions ke domain aur range maloom karein. To chaliye, wahin se shuru karte hain.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
Is poore unit mein do lafz baar baar aayenge, is liye inhein abhi pakka kar lein:
Domain (input ka set): woh tamaam values jo function ke andar daali ja sakti hain, yani \(\theta\) ki woh values jin par function ki koi value banti ho.
Range (output ka set): woh tamaam values jo function sach mein bahar nikaalta hai.
Function ko ek machine samjhiye, jaise juice wali machine. Domain woh sab cheezein hain jo aap machine mein daal sakte hain; range woh sab hai jo bahar aa sakta hai. Misal: \(f(x) = \sqrt{x}\) (sirf real values) mein negative number daalna mana hai, is liye domain \(x \ge 0\) hai, aur jawab bhi kabhi negative nahin aata, is liye range \(y \ge 0\) hai.

Ab kitab ki baat. Hum pehle hi chhe trigonometric functions define kar chuke hain: \(\sin\theta\), \(\cos\theta\), \(\tan\theta\), \(\csc\theta\), \(\sec\theta\) aur \(\cot\theta\). Hum jaante hain ke agar \(P(x, y)\) unit circle (radius 1 wala daira) par koi point ho jis ka centre origin \(O\) par hai, aur \(m\angle XOP = \theta\) standard position mein ho (yani angle positive \(x\)-axis se shuru ho), to

blocks.text_alt: cos theta equals x and sin theta equals y

blocks.alt: Unit circle with centre O at the origin, axes X prime X and Y prime Y. It meets the axes at A(1, 0), B(0, 1), C(minus 1, 0) and D(0, minus 1). The terminal side OP, drawn as an arrow, makes angle theta with OX; P(x, y) is on the circle, M is the foot of the perpendicular PM on OX, OM = x and MP = y.
blocks.caption: Figure 11.1: unit circle with P(x, y) on the terminal side of θ (original drawing after the textbook's figure)

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
Figure 11.1 ko ghaur se dekhiye. Unit circle ka matlab hai radius 1. Right triangle \(OMP\) mein hypotenuse \(OP = 1\) hai, base \(OM = x\) aur perpendicular \(MP = y\). Ab purani definitions lagaiye:
\[\cos\theta = \dfrac{OM}{OP} = \dfrac{x}{1} = x\]
\[\sin\theta = \dfrac{MP}{OP} = \dfrac{y}{1} = y\]
Kyun ke hypotenuse 1 hai, is liye divide karne ka jhanjhat hi khatam ho gaya. Yahi unit circle ka kamaal hai: point \(P\) ke coordinates seedhe seedhe \(\cos\theta\) aur \(\sin\theta\) hain. Aur \(x\), \(y\) ke signs khud hi har quadrant (chauthai hissa) mein sahi sign de dete hain.

\(\Rightarrow\) kisi bhi real number \(\theta\) ke liye \(x\) ki ek aur sirf ek value hoti hai, aur \(y\) ki bhi ek aur sirf ek value, yani \(\cos\theta\) aur \(\sin\theta\) dono ki ek ek value.
Is liye \(\sin\theta\) aur \(\cos\theta\), \(\theta\) ke functions hain aur in ka domain \(\mathbb{R}\) hai, yani tamaam real numbers ka set.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
Har real number kyun allowed hai? Yahan \(\theta\) radians mein naapa jata hai, is liye woh ek real number hi hai. \(\theta\) kuch bhi ho: positive, negative, \(2\pi\) se bara, ya fraction. Hum terminal side \(OP\) ko utna ghuma sakte hain, aur woh unit circle ko hamesha theek ek point \(P\) par kaategi. Us point ka ek \(x\) aur ek \(y\) hai, is liye \(\cos\theta\) aur \(\sin\theta\) hamesha maujood aur unique (akele) hain.
Ek aur baat: \(\sin\theta = y\) aur \(\cos\theta = x\) mein kisi cheez se divide nahin ho raha. Jahan division nahin, wahan zero se divide hone ka khatra bhi nahin. Is liye kisi \(\theta\) ko domain se nikaalne ki zaroorat nahin. (Aage tan, cot, sec, cosec mein division aayega, aur wahan kuch values nikaalni paregi.)

Ab range ki taraf chalte hain. Kyun ke \(P(x, y)\) unit circle par ek point hai jis ka centre origin \(O\) hai, is liye
\[-1 \le x \le 1 \quad \text{and} \quad -1 \le y \le 1\]
\[\Rightarrow -1 \le \cos\theta \le 1\]
\[\text{and} \quad -1 \le \sin\theta \le 1\]
Chunanche sine aur cosine functions ki range \([-1, 1]\) hai.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
\(x\) aur \(y\) \(-1\) aur \(1\) se bahar kyun nahin ja sakte? Unit circle ke har point par \(x^{2} + y^{2} = 1\) hota hai (Pythagoras). Ab \(y^{2}\) kabhi negative nahin hota, is liye \(x^{2}\) zyada se zyada 1 ho sakta hai: \(x^{2} \le 1\), yani \(-1 \le x \le 1\). Bilkul isi tarah \(-1 \le y \le 1\).
Seedhi si misaal: aap ek rassi ke ek sire ko khoonte se baandh kar doosra sira pakar kar gol chakkar lagayein jis ki lambai 1 meter ho. Aap khoonte se 1 meter se zyada door ja hi nahin sakte, na daayein na baayein, na upar na neeche.
Aur kya \(-1\) aur \(1\) ke darmiyan har value milti hai? Haan. Jab \(P\) circle par ek chakkar lagata hai to \(x\) lagataar \(1\) se \(-1\) tak jaata hai aur wapas aata hai, beech mein koi value nahin chhorta. \(y\) ka bhi yahi haal hai. Is liye range poora closed interval \([-1, 1]\) hai, kinaare (end points) samait.

blocks.caption: Hamari teaching table (kitab mein nahin): Figure 11.1 ke chaar points jahan circle axes ko kaat'ta hai, wahan cos aur sin parhiye. Sab se bari value 1 aur sab se chhoti value -1 dono yahin milti hain.

blocks.title: Khud sochiye
blocks.text:
Upar wali table ko dekh kar batayein: \(\sin\theta\) sab se bara kis angle par hota hai, aur \(\cos\theta\) sab se chhota kis angle par?
Jawab: \(\sin\theta = 1\) jab \(\theta = \frac{\pi}{2}\) (point \(B\), circle ki choti par), aur \(\cos\theta = -1\) jab \(\theta = \pi\) (point \(C\), bilkul baayein). Figure par ungli rakh kar dekhiye, baat foran samajh aa jayegi.

blocks.title: Hamari taraf se misaal
blocks.text:
Kya koi angle aisa hai jis par \(\cos\theta = 0.6\) ho? Haan, kyun ke \(0.6\) range \([-1, 1]\) ke andar hai. Circle par woh point dhoondhiye jis ka \(x = 0.6\); Pythagoras se \(y = \pm\sqrt{1 - 0.36} = \pm 0.8\). Yani point \((0.6, 0.8)\) par \(\cos\theta = 0.6\) aur \(\sin\theta = 0.8\).
Aur kya \(\sin\theta = 1.2\) mumkin hai? Nahin, kyun ke circle par koi point \(y = 1.2\) par hai hi nahin; circle ki sab se oonchi jagah \(y = 1\) hai.

blocks.title: Exam tip
blocks.text:
Range ki madad se namumkin equations foran pehchaan lein. \(\sin\theta = 2\) ya \(\cos\theta = -1.5\) ka koi hal nahin, kyun ke value \([-1, 1]\) se bahar hai. MCQ mein yeh sawal bohat aata hai.
Lekin \(\sin\theta = 1\) aur \(\cos\theta = -1\) bilkul mumkin hain (\(\theta = \frac{\pi}{2}\) aur \(\theta = \pi\) par); end points range mein shaamil hain.

blocks.title: Yaad rakhne wali baatein
blocks.text:
1. Unit circle par \(\cos\theta = x\) aur \(\sin\theta = y\), jahan \(P(x, y)\) angle \(\theta\) ki terminal side par hai.
2. \(\sin\) aur \(\cos\) ka domain: \(\mathbb{R}\), yani har real number.
3. \(\sin\) aur \(\cos\) ki range: \([-1, 1]\), yani \(-1 \le \sin\theta \le 1\) aur \(-1 \le \cos\theta \le 1\).
4. Inteha (extreme) values: \(\sin\theta = 1\) at \(\frac{\pi}{2}\), \(-1\) at \(\frac{3\pi}{2}\); \(\cos\theta = 1\) at \(0\), \(-1\) at \(\pi\).
5. Domain input (\(\theta\)) ki baat hai, range output (\(\sin\theta\), \(\cos\theta\)) ki.

blocks.title: Aam ghaltiyan
blocks.text:
1. Domain aur range ko aapas mein mila dena. Yaad rakhiye: domain \(\theta\) ke baare mein hai (andar kya ja sakta hai), range \(\sin\theta\) ya \(\cos\theta\) ke baare mein (bahar kya aata hai).
2. Range ko \((-1, 1)\) gol brackets ke saath likhna. \(-1\) aur \(1\) dono values milti hain, is liye square brackets \([-1, 1]\) zaroori hain. Gol bracket ka matlab hota hai kinaare shaamil nahin.
3. Yeh samajhna ke \(\theta\) khud \(0\) aur \(2\pi\) ke darmiyan hona chahiye. Angle koi bhi real number ho sakta hai; pabandi sirf jawab (output) par hai.
Dhyan dein: "range \([-1, 1]\)" ka matlab yeh nahin ke \(\theta\) chhota hai; \(\theta = 100\) radians par bhi \(\sin\theta\) isi range mein rahega.
